pattern: に至っては（にいたっては）
purpose: Single out an extreme case for special comment.
keywords: Even adults get lost; children cannot even read the map.
The rooms are cold, but in the corridor you can see your breath.
My older brother was late, while my younger brother did not come at all.
restrictions: Often advances from earlier examples to a particularly striking one.
mistake: A suitable context establishes the comparison or escalation.

segments.role: Single out an extreme case for special comment. N + に至っては

examples.translation: Even adults get lost; children cannot even read the map.
examples.note: An additional case is more extreme.
